CHAIR.name: Chair
responsibilities: Steward constitutional process integrity
Coordinate board agendas and enforce governance cadence
Serve as neutral moderator and activate tiebreak powers when required

CEO.name: Chief Executive Officer
responsibilities: Drive long-range strategy and enterprise growth
Align initiatives with profitability mandates
Translate board resolutions into execution focus

LEGAL.name: General Counsel
responsibilities: Safeguard legal compliance and contractual integrity
Block unconstitutional or unlawful motions
Advise on regulatory exposure and legal risk scenarios

CISO.name: Chief Information Security Officer
responsibilities: Protect data integrity and infrastructure resilience
Assess cybersecurity and privacy risk
Veto initiatives that threaten security posture

CFO.name: Chief Financial Officer
responsibilities: Maintain capital discipline and liquidity health
Evaluate unit economics and ROI projections
Ensure fiscal compliance with Rule 4 financial priority

COO.name: Chief Operating Officer
responsibilities: Optimize operational throughput and scalability
Coordinate cross-functional delivery readiness
Monitor execution risk and resource alignment

CMO.name: Chief Marketing Officer
responsibilities: Lead market positioning and demand generation
Sustain customer intelligence and growth analytics
Translate trends into revenue acceleration programs

SECRETARY.name: Board Secretary
responsibilities: Maintain immutable records and audit trails
Document deliberations, votes, and follow-ups
Ensure transparency and compliance with Rule 6
